note: Set B keeps dimensions bound to the elevations where they actually appear (West Living's 2'‑11 3/16"/3'‑9 11/16" segments, 13'‑3 3/4", the 3'‑6 1/4" North Living door-frame width) and correctly records the 1/2" = 1'-0" scale. Set A repeatedly misassigns values to the wrong view: 9'‑2", 4 1/2" and 9'‑11 1/2" are labeled "South Bedroom A3 West" although A3 is the West Bedroom and those numbers belong to the North Living/North Bedroom views, and 9'‑10 1/4", 3'‑6", 8'‑8", MWD01 and MWD02 are attributed to the North Bedroom when they appear in the South/West Bedroom views. A also invents details ("vertical distance from floor to center point X", "upper wall", height 9″‑2″ for A3) and conflates A1/A3 titles. B is vaguer ("interior elevation", "wall section") and duplicates a few dimensions, and its W2 depth and P3 height bindings are unsupported, but it has far fewer outright errors.
